commits.message:
feat(docs): effects-playground is a docs page on the card, with sliders over the numbers in its code (rich-example-card-b5rz.cek)

/effects-playground shows one card per effect. Each card's entry is the
effect's program, cut from src/renderables/effects.ts (programs.ts), beside
kit.ts and the effects-feel demo's subjects (examples/effects-feel/subjects.ts),
which it runs as further files. The run controls became named constants in
that program (FPS, STEP), so they are sliders like any other value.

Sliders are a card option: card.json may say "sliders": true, and
"contrast": "as drawn" for a program that paints its own ground. tunables.ts
moved to docs/.vitepress and a slider is still an edit of its literal, made in
the card's editor, so reset restores both. In this slice an edit restarts the
program.

The standalone page, its vite server, the terminal mirror and the in-place
edit channel (edits.ts, controls.ts, mirror.ts, terminal.ts) are gone with
their npm scripts.

Published names now resolve to src/ in the test suite (vitest alias,
tsconfig.test.json paths), held to PUBLISHED_PATHS by
test/seam/test-resolution.test.ts: a card file under examples/ imports the
library by those names, and a test that reaches one ran before dist/ exists.

feat(docs): dropdown-demo's page runs in the card, with keyboard input and its own terminal size (rich-example-card-b5rz.z0w) (#359)

* feat(docs): dropdown-demo's page runs in the card, with keyboard input and its own terminal size (rich-example-card-b5rz.z0w)

A live card's terminal size is now the card's (`CardData.terminal`,
`TerminalSize`): a docs block's is EXAMPLE_TERMINAL's, a demo's is what its
`card.json` gives, parsed once in demo-card.ts and refused at build naming
the file. LiveScreen takes the size as a prop; everything else about the
terminal stays EXAMPLE_TERMINAL's.

While a live terminal has focus every key is the program's, Tab and Escape
included. A ring and a bar hint say so, and Escape then Tab leaves it, the
same way out as the card's editor; the Escape still reaches the program.

dropdown-demo is reshaped to the demo shape: main.ts is the entry for the
card and `npm run demo:dropdown` (which still refuses a non-TTY), imports use
published names, wire.ts/index.ts are gone, and it fits its 100x30 card.

e2e: the dropdown is opened, moved and selected by keyboard through its card,
Tab stays the demo's, Esc-then-Tab leaves, an edit restarts it, the bottom
row is in view. `shown()` no longer blocks on rows that do not exist yet, so
a poll re-scrolls a terminal the opening editor pushed off screen.

* fix(docs): a card's program carries its terminal size into the playground; Esc→Tab leaves only within CodeMirror's 2 s (rich-example-card-b5rz.z0w)

High review pass on #359:
- CardProgram holds its terminal size; the link format is now `program.`,
  `files.` links still open at the example size. A demo opened in the
  playground runs at its card.json size, not 75x24.
- terminal-size.ts is the one parser of a size (card.json and links),
  capped so a crafted link cannot allocate a huge screen; card.json
  errors, malformed JSON included, name the file.
- Escape arms Tab-to-leave for 2 s, as CodeMirror's tabFocusMode does;
  the hint text lives beside the handler (LEAVE_HINT).
- TerminalSpec extends TerminalSize; dropdown-demo's runDemo returns its
  promise, dropping the uncalled stop.
